ADMIN_PASS.description: Use a unique, high-entropy dashboard password.

JWT_SECRET.description: Generate at least 32 random characters, for example with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Generate a different random value of at least 32 characters for encrypting notification credentials.

PINGFLARE_INSTANCE_ID.description: Short label used to distinguish this deployment in Analytics Engine.

API_ANALYTICS_SAMPLE_RATE.description: Fraction of successful API requests written to Analytics Engine. The default `0.05` records 5%; errors are always recorded.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,cron -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:cron"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.deploy: npm run build && node scripts/reconcile-legacy-migration.mjs && npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy
